sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Large centered hero with headline, subtitle, optional badge pill, optional copyable starter prompt, primary and secondary CTA buttons, and a decorative GitHub contribution-style SVG grid background.
sections.useWhen: Top of a landing page when you want a centered headline, optional badge, optional copyable starter prompt and up to two CTAs.

title.description: Main headline text rendered as h1

subtitle.description: Supporting text rendered as paragraph; supports HTML via set:html

primaryCta.description: Primary button with shine hover effect, shadow-primary/30, and scale-105 on hover

badge.description: Pill above the headline. Rendered as a link when href is set. Omit to hide it. All text comes from the prop; nothing is hardcoded.

prompt.description: Optional starter prompt rendered in a copyable code block below the subtitle, with a copy-to-clipboard button. Intended to hand a coding agent a kickoff prompt.

sections.notes: Min height 70vh. Demo index passes badge={{ label: 'v4.0 — Open Source & MIT', href: '/changelog' }}.

sections.name: HeroGradient
sections.description: Centered hero with an animated gradient glow background — three large blurred OKLCH orbs that drift slowly via a CSS float animation. Glow intensity is stronger in dark mode. Same content structure as Hero (badge, title, subtitle, two CTAs) without the contribution-grid background.
sections.useWhen: Top of a landing page that should feel premium: centered headline over an animated gradient glow instead of the grid pattern.

title.description: Main headline text rendered as h1

subtitle.description: Supporting text rendered as paragraph; supports HTML via set:html

primaryCta.description: Primary button with shine hover effect

badge.description: Optional pill badge text shown above the headline, linking to /changelog

sections.notes: Orb colors and opacity are defined via CSS custom properties in the component <style> block. Respects prefers-reduced-motion (animation disabled). Use as a premium alternative to Hero on landing pages.

sections.name: HeroSplit
sections.description: Split-layout hero: text column (tagline pill, h1, subtitle, CTAs) on the left and a visual on the right. Renders a decorative browser-window mock-up when no image is passed. Stacks vertically on mobile (md:grid-cols-2).
sections.useWhen: Product landing pages that need text on the left and a visual or screenshot on the right.

title.description: Main headline text rendered as h1

subtitle.description: Supporting text rendered as paragraph; supports HTML via set:html

tagline.description: Small pill above the headline (e.g. "Now in Beta"); omit to hide

image.description: Replaces the decorative mock-up with a real image; alt is required for accessibility

sections.notes: Designed for product landing pages. Left column uses data-animate="slide-left", right column data-animate="slide-right".

sections.name: Features
sections.description: Feature grid section with icon cards displayed in a bordered, shadowed grid (bg-border gap-px overflow-hidden). Each card shows an SVG icon, title, and description. Icons come from the shared icon set in src/lib/icons.ts.
sections.useWhen: A grid of 3 to 9 benefits, each with a built-in icon, title and description.

subtitle.description: Optional supporting text below the heading

features.description: Array of feature cards. icon must be an IconName exported from src/lib/icons.ts (zap, shield, chart, users, globe, lock, heart, star, clock, calendar, map-pin, phone, mail, check, sparkles, leaf, rocket, code, palette, message, camera, book, home, settings). Unknown names are a TypeScript error.

sections.example:
---
import Features from "@/components/sections/Features.astro";
---

<Features
  title="Why choose this starter?"
  subtitle="Everything you need to build fast"
  features={[
    { icon: "zap", title: "Fast by default", description: "Static HTML with minimal JavaScript." },
    { icon: "shield", title: "Type safe", description: "TypeScript props on every section." },
    { icon: "globe", title: "SEO ready", description: "Meta tags, sitemap and structured data." },
  ]}
/>
sections.notes: Grid is sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3. To add icons, add a key + 24x24 stroke path to src/lib/icons.ts; IconName updates automatically.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.description: Pricing tiers section with a responsive 3-column card grid. Supports highlighting one tier (visual emphasis with border-primary, shadow, and scale-105). Highlighted tiers get a filled primary CTA button; others get an outlined button. An optional period (e.g. '/month') is shown after the price; an optional note renders below the tiers.
sections.useWhen: Showing 1 to 3 plans side by side with a feature list and a CTA per plan; one plan can be highlighted.

subtitle.description: Optional supporting text below the heading

tiers.description: Array of pricing tiers. Set highlighted: true on at most one tier. price is a free-form string that includes the currency (e.g. '$29', 'Free', 'Custom'). period is optional (e.g. '/month') and is only rendered when set.

note.description: Optional small print below the tier cards (e.g. 'Prices exclude VAT.')

sections.example:
---
import Pricing from "@/components/sections/Pricing.astro";
---

<Pricing
  title="Simple pricing"
  subtitle="Pick the plan that fits"
  note="Prices exclude VAT."
  tiers={[
    {
      name: "Free",
      price: "$0",
      description: "For side projects",
      features: ["1 project", "Community support"],
      cta: { label: "Start free", href: "/signup" },
    },
    {
      name: "Pro",
      price: "$29",
      period: "/month",
      description: "For teams",
      features: ["Unlimited projects", "Priority support"],
      cta: { label: "Subscribe", href: "/signup" },
      highlighted: true,
    },
  ]}
/>
sections.notes: Grid is lg:grid-cols-3. Nothing is appended to the price automatically; pass period for recurring plans.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.description: Testimonial card grid section. Each card shows a blockquote, auto-generated avatar initials, author name, role, and company. No image support — avatars are initials-only.
sections.useWhen: Quotes from real people who gave permission. Never invent quotes or companies.

testimonials.description: Array of testimonial objects. Author initials are derived from the author name automatically.

sections.notes: Grid is md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Avatar is a muted circle with initials — no photo upload needed.

sections.name: CTA
sections.description: Call-to-action section with a rounded, muted card (bg-muted/50) containing a headline, description text, and a single primary CTA button. Centered layout.
sections.useWhen: A closing call to action with one headline, one sentence and one button.
sections.example:
---
import CTA from "@/components/sections/CTA.astro";
---

<CTA
  title="Ready to get started?"
  description="Clone the repo and ship your first page today."
  cta={{ label: "Get started", href: "/docs" }}
/>
sections.notes: No secondary CTA. If two buttons are needed, use a custom section or extend this component.

sections.name: ContentBlock
sections.description: Content section with a text column (tagline, h2, description, optional feature bullet list) and an optional image. With an image it renders two columns (image left or right); without one it renders a single text column.
sections.useWhen: A text block with an optional bullet list, alone or next to a real image (photo, screenshot) the user supplied; alternate imageSide for rhythm. Never pass a stock or placeholder image.

tagline.description: Small uppercase label rendered above the heading in primary color

description.description: Body text rendered as a paragraph

features.description: Optional list of feature bullet points rendered with checkmark SVG icons

image.description: Optional image. An imported image (import photo from '@/assets/photo.jpg') is optimized with astro:assets; a string is used as a URL or public/ path and rendered lazily at 4:3. Omit it to render a single text column.

imageSide.description: Which side the image column appears on when image is set. 'left' uses lg:grid-flow-dense to reorder columns visually. Ignored without image.

sections.notes: Without image the section is a single text column (max-w-3xl); there is no placeholder. Pass image only with a real image the user supplied.

sections.name: LogoCloud
sections.description: Single-row logo bar with a leading label. Each logo is an image (src), a built-in icon (icon), or just a name, and can link out (href). All content comes from props.
sections.useWhen: A single row of logos (your own stack or real customers who agreed) with a leading label.

title.description: Label displayed before the logo row; omitted when not set

logos.description: Logos to show. src is an image URL (single-colour SVG recommended, inverted in dark mode); icon is a name from src/lib/icons.ts. Only show logos you have the right to display.

sections.notes: Demo logo files live in public/icons/tech/. Layout: grid on mobile, flex-row on lg.

sections.name: IntegrationGrid
sections.description: Two-column section: pill, heading, optional rich-text slot and optional CTA on the left; bordered 2-column grid of linked items (tools, integrations, partners) on the right with an optional 'footer' slot below the grid.
sections.useWhen: Listing tools, integrations or partners as a grid of linked cards next to a short intro text.

items.description: Grid cards. iconSrc (image URL, single-colour SVG, inverted in dark mode) wins over icon (name from src/lib/icons.ts). Links open in a new tab.

cta.description: Optional outlined button under the left column text

sections.example:
--- import IntegrationGrid from "@/components/sections/IntegrationGrid.astro"; ---

Longer description shown under the title (optional slot).

Optional small print under the grid.
sections.notes: Slots: default (left-column body copy, links styled automatically) and 'footer' (small print under the grid). Renamed from AIFeature in 4.0; the AI tool list now lives in src/pages/index.astro.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.description: Accordion-style FAQ section using CSS-only <details>/<summary> elements with smooth height animation. Includes Schema.org FAQPage structured data (LD+JSON) for SEO rich results.
sections.useWhen: Answering common questions; renders FAQPage structured data for search engines.
sections.example:
---
import FAQ from "@/components/sections/FAQ.astro";
---

<FAQ
  title="Frequently asked questions"
  subtitle="Everything you need to know"
  faqs={[
    { question: "Is it free?", answer: "Yes, it is MIT licensed." },
    { question: "Does it support dark mode?", answer: "Yes, all sections use theme tokens." },
  ]}
/>
sections.notes: Uses name='faq' attribute on <details> for exclusive accordion behavior (only one open at a time). No JavaScript required. The + icon rotates to x when open.

sections.name: Stats
sections.description: Key metrics grid with large values, labels, and optional descriptions. Values are strings for flexible formatting (e.g. '10K+', '99.9%', '$0').
sections.useWhen: Showing a handful of real, verifiable numbers. Do not use invented statistics.
sections.notes: Uses <dl>/<dd>/<dt> semantic markup. Grid is 2 cols on mobile, 4 on desktop with dividers. Has border-y for visual framing.

sections.name: Team
sections.description: Team member grid with avatar (image or auto-generated initials), name, role, optional bio, and social links (GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter/X).
sections.useWhen: Introducing real team members with role, bio and optional social links.
sections.notes: Grid: 1 col mobile, 2 tablet, 3 desktop, 4 on xl. Cards have hover lift effect. Initials auto-derived from name when no image provided. Social icons are inline SVGs.

sections.name: Comparison
sections.description: Feature comparison table across multiple products/services. Supports boolean (checkmark/dash) and string values. One column can be highlighted.
sections.useWhen: A feature table comparing your product with alternatives across 2 to 4 columns, one column highlighted.

features.description: Feature rows with one value per column

sections.notes: Semantic <table> with sticky first column on mobile scroll. Highlighted column gets bg-primary/8 tint and 'Recommended' badge. Alternating row stripes.

sections.name: Newsletter
sections.description: Email signup section with centered card layout containing headline, description, inline email form, and privacy note.
sections.useWhen: An email signup form that posts to your newsletter provider or backend (action is required).

action.description: Form endpoint (your newsletter provider or backend). Required.

sections.example:
---
import Newsletter from "@/components/sections/Newsletter.astro";
---

<Newsletter
  action="https://your-provider.example/subscribe"
  method="post"
  title="Stay in the loop"
  description="One email per release. Unsubscribe any time."
  buttonText="Subscribe"
/>
sections.notes: action is required: point it at your provider/backend. The demo pages use action='/thanks' method='get' (a demo-only page explaining how to connect a backend). Has bg-muted/30 background. Includes 'No spam. Unsubscribe anytime.' privacy note.

sections.name: Contact
sections.description: Two-column contact section with info (email, phone, address) on the left and, when the form prop is given, a 4-field form (name, email, subject, message) on the right.
sections.useWhen: Contact details with an optional contact form posting to your own backend (omit form for info only).

headingLevel.description: Heading tag for the title; use h1 when the section is the page's main heading

form.description: Renders the contact form. Omit to show contact info only (no form is rendered). method defaults to 'post'; submitLabel defaults to 'Send Message'.

sections.example:
---
import Contact from "@/components/sections/Contact.astro";
---

<Contact
  title="Get in touch"
  subtitle="Questions or feedback? Write to us."
  email="hello@example.com"
  form={{ action: "https://your-form-backend.example/submit", method: "post", submitLabel: "Send message" }}
/>
sections.notes: The demo pages use form={{ action: '/thanks', method: 'get' }} (demo-only page). Required fields marked with red asterisk. Native HTML form elements (no React). Stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop.

ui.name: Button
ui.description: shadcn/ui Button component built with class-variance-authority (CVA) and Radix UI Slot. Supports asChild pattern for rendering as any element.
ui.useWhen: Any clickable action. Use variant for emphasis; use asChild to style a link as a button.

size.description: Size variant. icon = h-10 w-10 square.

asChild.description: When true, renders as the child element via Radix Slot instead of a <button>

ui.example:
---
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
---

<Button client:load>Default</Button>
<Button client:load variant="secondary">Secondary</Button>
<Button client:load variant="outline">Outline</Button>
<Button client:load variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>
<Button client:load variant="destructive">Destructive</Button>
<Button client:load variant="link">Link</Button>
<Button client:load size="sm">Small</Button>
<Button client:load size="lg">Large</Button>
ui.notes: Use client:load only when wrapping interactive React components. For static anchor links in .astro files, prefer native <a> tags styled with the same Tailwind classes used in section components.

ui.name: Card
ui.description: shadcn/ui Card compound component. Exports Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter sub-components.
ui.useWhen: Grouping related content in a bordered surface with header, content and footer parts.

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example:
--- import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"; --- Card Title Card description goes here.

Card content and details.
ui.notes: Base Card renders as a rounded-lg border bg-card shadow-sm div. All sub-components accept standard HTMLDivElement/heading attributes plus className.

ui.name: Badge
ui.description: shadcn/ui Badge component built with CVA. Pill-shaped label for status, tags, or categories.

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example:
---
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
---

<Badge client:load>Default</Badge>
<Badge client:load variant="secondary">Secondary</Badge>
<Badge client:load variant="outline">Outline</Badge>
<Badge client:load variant="destructive">Destructive</Badge>
ui.notes: Renders as a <div> (not a <span>). Use className to override styles.

ui.name: Input
ui.description: shadcn/ui Input component. Styled text input with consistent focus ring, disabled states, and file input support.
ui.useWhen: Single-line form fields; pair with Label for accessibility.

type.description: HTML input type attribute (text, email, password, file, etc.)

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example: --- import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"; import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"; ---
ui.notes: Passes all standard HTMLInputElement attributes through. Height is h-10. Full-width by default (w-full).

ui.name: Label
ui.description: shadcn/ui Label component built on Radix UI LabelPrimitive. Properly associates with form controls for accessibility.
ui.useWhen: Accessible label for a form control; pair with Input.

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example: --- import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"; import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"; ---
ui.notes: Use htmlFor to associate with an Input's id. Automatically styles as disabled when peer input is disabled (peer-disabled:opacity-70).

ui.name: Accordion
ui.description: shadcn/ui Accordion built on Radix UI Accordion. Vertically stacked expandable panels with animated open/close (accordion-down / accordion-up keyframes from globals.css).
ui.useWhen: Collapsible content groups where the user opens one or several items.

type.description: single = only one item open at a time; multiple = any number open

collapsible.description: With type="single", allows closing the open item by clicking it again

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example:
---
import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from "@/components/ui/accordion";
---

<Accordion type="single" collapsible client:load>
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section One</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content for section one.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="item-2">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section Two</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content for section two.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
ui.notes: Each AccordionItem needs a unique value prop. For static FAQ content without JS, prefer the FAQ section (native <details>) instead.

ui.name: Dialog
ui.description: shadcn/ui Dialog (modal) built on Radix UI Dialog. Renders in a portal with a backdrop overlay, focus trap, Escape-to-close, and a built-in close button with sr-only label.
ui.useWhen: Modal dialogs that interrupt the flow for confirmation or short forms.

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example:
--- import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@/components/ui/dialog"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"; --- Dialog Title This is a dialog description.

Dialog body content goes here.
ui.notes: Always include DialogTitle (and ideally DialogDescription) inside DialogContent — Radix warns and screen readers lose context without them. Use DialogTrigger asChild to wrap a Button.

ui.name: DropdownMenu
ui.description: shadcn/ui DropdownMenu built on Radix UI DropdownMenu. Trigger-anchored menu with items, checkbox items, radio groups, labels, separators, keyboard shortcuts hints, and nested sub-menus.
ui.useWhen: Action menus attached to a trigger button.

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example:
---
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
---

<DropdownMenu client:load>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline">Open Menu</Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuLabel>Actions</DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem>Edit</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem>Duplicate</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem>Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
ui.notes: Use DropdownMenuTrigger asChild to wrap a Button. DropdownMenuShortcut is purely visual — it does not register keyboard shortcuts.

ui.name: Select
ui.description: shadcn/ui Select built on Radix UI Select. Custom-styled single-value select with a trigger button, popover list, groups, labels, separators, and scroll buttons for long lists.
ui.useWhen: Choosing one option from a list in a form.

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example:
---
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from "@/components/ui/select";
---

<Select client:load>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select option" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="option1">Option 1</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="option2">Option 2</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="option3">Option 3</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
ui.notes: SelectTrigger needs an accessible name: pair it with a Label via id/htmlFor or pass aria-label. Put the placeholder on SelectValue, not on the trigger.

ui.name: Tabs
ui.description: shadcn/ui Tabs built on Radix UI Tabs. Horizontal tab list with roving keyboard focus and a content panel per tab.
ui.useWhen: Switching between related views in the same space.

defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initially active tab (matches a TabsTrigger/TabsContent value)

onValueChange.description: Callback when the active tab changes

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example:
---
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
---

<Tabs defaultValue="tab1" client:load>
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="tab1">Tab 1</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="tab2">Tab 2</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="tab3">Tab 3</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="tab1">First tab content.</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="tab2">Second tab content.</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="tab3">Third tab content.</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
ui.notes: Each TabsTrigger and TabsContent pair must share the same value. Arrow keys move between tabs; Home/End jump to first/last.

ui.name: Tooltip
ui.description: shadcn/ui Tooltip built on Radix UI Tooltip. Small popover shown on hover or keyboard focus of the trigger, with a fade/zoom animation.
ui.useWhen: Short hover/focus hints for icon buttons or abbreviations.

delayDuration.description: Delay in ms before the tooltip opens (set on TooltipProvider or Tooltip)

sideOffset.description: Distance in px between trigger and TooltipContent

className.description: Additional Tailwind classes merged via cn()

ui.example:
--- import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"; ---

Tooltip text
ui.notes: Wrap tooltips in a single TooltipProvider per island. Tooltips are for supplementary hints only — never put essential information exclusively in a tooltip.

layouts.name: BaseLayout
layouts.description: Default layout for content-focused pages. Includes Header, Footer, SEO meta tags (OpenGraph + Twitter Cards), ClientRouter for view transitions, ThemeScript for dark mode persistence, and Vercel Analytics. Content is boxed (max-w-5xl via container).
layouts.useWhen: Default page shell: header, footer, SEO and a boxed max-w-5xl content area. Use for most content pages.

title.description: Page title — appended with '| AstroDeck' automatically

description.description: Meta description for SEO and OpenGraph

type.description: OpenGraph type — use 'article' for blog posts

publishedTime.description: Article published time (only relevant when type='article')

author.description: Article author name (only relevant when type='article')

noindex.description: Adds <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> — for pages that must not be indexed

layouts.example:
--- import BaseLayout from "@/layouts/BaseLayout.astro"; ---

About
layouts.notes: Includes a visually hidden skip-to-content link for accessibility. Header and Footer are always rendered.

layouts.name: FullWidthLayout
layouts.description: Layout for showcase pages, portfolios, and galleries requiring full viewport width. Same structure as BaseLayout but without max-width constraint on main (w-full). Header and Footer use variant='fullWidth'. No Vercel Analytics.
layouts.useWhen: Showcase and landing pages whose sections span the full viewport width; keeps header and footer.

title.description: Page title — appended with '| AstroDeck' automatically

description.description: Meta description for SEO and OpenGraph

noindex.description: Adds <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> — for pages that must not be indexed

layouts.example:
---
import FullWidthLayout from "@/layouts/FullWidthLayout.astro";
---

<FullWidthLayout title="Showcase" description="Full-width page">
  <!-- sections go here -->
</FullWidthLayout>
layouts.notes: Does not include Vercel Analytics (unlike BaseLayout). Header and Footer receive variant='fullWidth'.

layouts.name: MinimalLayout
layouts.description: Bare layout with no Header or Footer. Full-viewport main area. Ideal for 404 pages, maintenance pages, and standalone landing pages that need complete layout control. Supports optional noindex.
layouts.useWhen: Standalone pages without header or footer, such as 404, maintenance or a bare landing page.

title.description: Page title — appended with '| AstroDeck' automatically

description.description: Meta description for SEO and OpenGraph

noindex.description: When true, adds noindex meta tag to prevent search engine indexing

layouts.example:
--- import MinimalLayout from "@/layouts/MinimalLayout.astro"; ---

404
layouts.notes: No skip-to-content link, no Header, no Footer. main has id='main-content' and min-h-screen.

layouts.name: AuthLayout
layouts.description: Split-screen authentication layout. On desktop (lg+): left panel is a dark branding panel (bg-zinc-900) with Logo and an optional testimonial quote (only rendered when the testimonial prop is passed); right panel contains the slot with centered form content (max-w sm:w-[350px]). On mobile: only the right panel is visible. Always sets noindex=true on SEO.
layouts.useWhen: Login, signup and password-reset pages: split layout without header or footer, always noindex.

title.description: Page title — appended with '| AstroDeck' automatically

testimonial.type: { quote: string; author: string; role?: string }
testimonial.description: Optional quote shown in the branding panel. Nothing is rendered when omitted. Use only a real quote you have permission to use.

layouts.example:
---
import AuthLayout from "@/layouts/AuthLayout.astro";
---

<AuthLayout title="Sign in">
  <!-- login form -->
</AuthLayout>
layouts.notes: noindex is always true — cannot be overridden via props. The left-panel testimonial is optional and passed through the testimonial prop. The Logo component is auto-included. Slot content is constrained to sm:w-[350px] for form layout.

layouts.name: ArticleLayout
layouts.description: Blog article layout extending BaseLayout. Renders slot content inside a max-w-3xl article element with prose typography (Tailwind Typography plugin). Shows title as h1, and optionally renders publishDate and author below the heading.
layouts.useWhen: Long-form text (blog posts, articles) that needs prose typography with title, date and author.

title.description: Article title rendered as h1 and passed to BaseLayout

publishDate.description: Human-readable publish date string (also used as datetime attribute on <time>)

author.description: Author name displayed below the title

layouts.example:
--- import ArticleLayout from "@/layouts/ArticleLayout.astro"; ---

Markdown or HTML content is styled with prose.
layouts.notes: Inherits all BaseLayout features including Vercel Analytics. Content is wrapped in prose prose-neutral dark:prose-invert — add standard HTML/Markdown; no extra styling needed.
